overview: Pulse Nova is a kinetic arena shooter in a floating neon colosseum. Fire plasma bolts into cybernetic drone waves, create multi-kill explosions and use jump pads for aerial movement. A kinetic dash provides both burst movement and brief invulnerability as the arena pressure builds.
rules: Survive the incoming drone waves while shooting with the Pulse Blaster.
Use explosions to chain multiple kills.
Dash gives burst movement and temporary invulnerability.
Jump pads launch the player into the air, changing routes and firing positions.
controls: WASD moves; mouse aims; left click/E fires.
F5/F9 quick-save/load; R restarts; Escape menu.
story: The documented setting is a floating neon colosseum attacked by cybernetic drones. No narrative campaign or named protagonist is established.

characters.name: Cybernetic drones
characters.description: The enemy swarms attacking the floating neon colosseum; the player blasts them with kinetic plasma bolts and chains multi-kill explosions.
